observations: A squat, rounded figure sits centered on an orange-yellow ground; its body is rendered in layered olive and gold tones with red and green outline strokes tracing the edges.
Two glowing circular eyes burn orange-white at the face, and jagged white lightning lines radiate from two dark protrusions rising from the head into a sunburst background of red-orange rays.
The word 'BULLISH' appears in red lettering across the figure's midsection, partially transparent, as though printed through the body rather than sitting on top of it.
reading: The figure sits low and wide, its weight settled into the warm ground. Glowing eyes and crackling lines at the edges read as charged or agitated rather than calm. The radiating background rays push outward from behind the form, amplifying that sense of pressure. 'BULLISH' floats through the body like a label the figure is absorbing rather than wearing.
contextAngle: Within the owned nnotb subset, this work sits between title neighbors #89 and #91. All three use a single seated figure against a flat saturated field with scattered yellow-orange lightning marks — a recurring formal choice across these three owned works.

connections.reason: nnotb #91 uses the same red-orange field and a single seated figure with radiating yellow lines, but reduces the image to flat black silhouette and minimal line, where #90 builds layered color and texture on the same basic structure.

nnotb #89 shares jagged yellow-orange lightning marks scattered around its figures, but replaces the warm orange field with flat magenta, making the contrast between figure and ground starker than in #90.

lookingQuestion: Where exactly does the word 'BULLISH' sit in relation to the figure's body — does it appear in front of, behind, or merged with the form, and what visual evidence supports your reading?
ambiguities: The two dark protrusions from the head could be read as ears, wires, or abstract forms; the image does not resolve this clearly.

nifty faces #125 (QmdNNauR8jZWoZ3iFyBenrEu8ft2Rsi7S8NTb1pKi1psHK) shares a glowing circular eye treatment but belongs to a different collection family and the formal overlap is too limited to support a useful connection; omitted.
